# OyeRide

> Fast motor rides and reliable deliveries in Kasoa, Ghana. Book a ride or send a package in seconds.

OyeRide is a ride-hailing and delivery platform operating in Kasoa, Ghana. It connects passengers and senders with nearby motorcycle and bicycle riders through a mobile app.

## Services

- **Oye Motor Ride**: On-demand motorcycle taxi service for beating Kasoa traffic. Passengers book a rider, track them live on a map, and pay a transparent upfront fare.
- **Oye Motor Delivery**: Motorcycle-based package delivery for larger items or longer distances across Kasoa. Real-time tracking included.
- **Oye Bicycle Delivery**: Eco-friendly, zero-emission bicycle delivery for documents, food, and small parcels over short distances. The most affordable option.
- **Gas Refill**: Doorstep gas cylinder refill — a rider picks up the empty cylinder, has it refilled at a verified station, and returns it, same day.

## Platforms

- Android app (free download): https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.jehoshaphat12.oyeride
- iOS app (free download): https://apps.apple.com/app/oyeride/id6804677598
- Official website: https://oyeridegh.com/

## Key Features

- Real-time GPS tracking of driver from acceptance to destination
- Surge pricing based on demand, time of day, and location
- Live driver-to-pickup route shown on passenger map
- In-app push notifications at every ride stage
- 10% new user discount on first 2 completed rides
- In-app chat between passenger and driver
- Ride history and ratings
- Multi-stop bookings (up to 3 stops)

## Earn with OyeRide

- **Become a Rider**: Sign up as a motorcycle or bicycle rider inside the app and earn on a flexible schedule. https://oyeridegh.com/drive
- **Become a Courier**: Deliver parcels on a motorcycle or bicycle instead of carrying passengers. https://oyeridegh.com/courier
- **Fleet Owners**: List a fleet of motorcycles, manage multiple riders, and track every trip from a dashboard. https://oyeridegh.com/fleet
- **Merchants**: List a restaurant, shop, or pharmacy for delivery through OyeRide. https://oyeridegh.com/merchant

## Target Users

- Passengers in Kasoa needing fast, affordable transport
- Businesses and individuals sending packages across Kasoa
- Motorcycle and bicycle riders looking to earn income flexibly
- Local merchants who want delivery handled for them
